description: You are a law review managing editor preparing the final organization for a special issue on Technology and Privacy Law. Your Juris-M library contains 15 items — 8 law review articles and 7 court cases — with no organizational structure and several missing abstracts. Your tasks: (1) Create a parent collection named 'Tech & Privacy Special Issue' with three subcollections named exactly: 'Data Privacy Articles' (for law review articles about privacy theory and data governance), 'Digital Search Cases' (for court cases about electronic searches and the Fourth Amendment), and 'Surveillance Law' (for court cases and articles about mass surveillance programs and policy). Assign all 15 items to the appropriate subcollection. (2) Four law review articles are missing their abstract field — add a 1-3 sentence description of the article's topic to each. (3) Create a standalone note in Juris-M (not attached to any item) titled 'Table of Contents' that lists the titles of all 15 items in the library. (4) Open Juris-M Preferences and change the Quick Copy export format to 'Chicago Manual of Style 17th edition (full note)'. (5) Add the tag 'tech-privacy-2024' to all 15 items. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
